thread:
Maya (eng-oncall): Hey team — proposing a short standing 'handover pipeline' sync to tighten up how we surface open incidents into triage. 20 minutes, twice daily (09:00 UTC & 21:00 UTC). Agenda draft below, want quick +1s or edits before I book recurring invite.

Maya (eng-oncall): Agenda: 1) Quick rollcall & active incident summary (oncall-bot) 2) Escalation attendance check — who needs to join by incident class 3) Recent handoff gaps + one action item 4) Runbook / pager doc spot-check (1 case) 5) Any blocked rollouts impacting oncall

Jon R: +1 for the cadence. Can we make the second slot 20:30 UTC to better cover APAC? 21:00 is a bit late for a couple folks.

Li Chen: 20:30 works for me. Also please add a line to call out whether the incident has a customer impact tag so product/SRE get paged.

Andre P: Suggestion — rotate the 'escalation lead' each day so the same person isn't getting peppered. 3-day rotation seems fair.

Maya (eng-oncall): Good call on rotation. Proposal: 3-day rotation, and escalation lead is responsible to ping product/SRE on severity>=P2. I'll add to agenda.

Sarah D: Can we include a 3-min review of the latest runbook edits? Last week a runbook had outdated playbook steps and it slowed us down.

Nate S: oncall-bot can print runbook last-updated timestamps in the summary. /runbook status returns last modified for linked docs.

oncall-bot: Active incidents: 1) INC-2026 - database replication lag (P2) - owner: Li Chen 2) INC-2027 - streaming QPS spike (P3) - owner: Andre P 3) INC-2025 - auth flakiness (P1) - owner: Maya (on call). Runbook timestamps: db-repl.md (2026-11-28), streaming.md (2026-11-24), auth.md (2026-11-30).

Jon R: For escalation attendance, proposing: P1 -> SRE + Eng PM + Engineering lead; P2 -> Eng lead + oncall escalation lead; P3 -> oncall only unless requested. Thoughts?

Li Chen: That mapping looks good. One tweak: for P2 with customer-facing outages, auto-include Product. Maybe a boolean tag 'customer-impact'.

Maya (eng-oncall): Agreed. I'll add 'customer-impact' check to the pre-sync checklist (oncall-bot should flag).

Andre P: Also, can we add a 'handoff notes' template so the outgoing oncall leaves a quick summary: what was done, outstanding actions, suggested next steps. Keep to 3 bullets.

Maya (eng-oncall): Love it. I'll create a template in the handbook and link it in the invite.

Sarah D: One more ops nit: include timezone hints in invite (UTC + local) and mark "optional" for product/SRE invites unless auto-included by severity.

Maya (eng-oncall): Cool — final checklist I'll add before sending invite: - Recurrence: daily x2 (09:00, 20:30 UTC) - Duration: 20m - Rotation: 3-day escalation lead - Auto-includes: Product/SRE on P1 OR customer-impact tag - Runbook spot-check owner: whoever is listed as escalation lead - Handoff template link: added

Jon R: +1. Book it.

Li Chen: +1

Andre P: +1 :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Recurring meeting created by Maya (eng-oncall): "Handover pipeline / escalation attendance" — Tuesdays-Sundays 09:00 & 20:30 UTC. Link: https://cal.redwood.ai/meet/hand-over-pipeline

Maya (eng-oncall): Thanks all. I'll post calendar invite and handbook link here once live. If anyone has follow-ups for the agenda, drop them in thread.
